periods.name: Yangshao–Shang warm period
periods.summary: About two degrees warmer than today: elephants, rhinos and bamboo lived in the Yellow River valley, and the Shang hunted them.
periods.summary_zh: 比今天暖约 2°C，黄河流域有象、犀和竹林，殷人猎象。

periods.name: 4.2-kiloyear event
periods.summary: A worldwide dry and cool spell; in China the late Neolithic cultures (Liangzhu, Shimao, Taosi) declined and the flood stories of Yu took shape.
periods.summary_zh: 全球性的干冷事件；中国良渚、石峁、陶寺等龙山晚期文化衰落，大禹治水的传说由此而来。

periods.name: Western Zhou cold period
periods.summary: The Han River froze twice (903 and 897 BCE in the Bamboo Annals); droughts and nomad pressure followed, ending with the fall of Haojing in 771 BCE.
periods.summary_zh: 《竹书纪年》记周孝王时汉水两次结冰；随后旱灾与戎狄压力相继，终至公元前 771 年镐京陷落。

periods.name: Spring and Autumn–Han warm period
periods.summary: Plum and bamboo grew far north of their range today; the Qin and Han built their empires in a mild, wet climate.
periods.summary_zh: 梅、竹生长远比今天偏北；秦汉帝国在温和湿润的气候中建立。

periods.name: Eastern Han–Northern and Southern Dynasties cold period
periods.summary: Cold and dry centuries: steppe peoples moved south, the north broke up into the Sixteen Kingdoms and northern families fled south of the Yangtze.
periods.summary_zh: 寒冷干燥的几百年：草原民族南下，北方分裂为十六国，北方士族大批南渡。

periods.name: Sui–Tang warm period
periods.summary: Oranges and plum trees grew in Chang'an; harvests in the north were good through the high Tang.
periods.summary_zh: 长安能种柑橘和梅；盛唐时北方农业丰收。

periods.name: Late Tang cold spell
periods.summary: Colder, drier decades with drought and locusts in the north, the background of Huang Chao's rising.
periods.summary_zh: 晚唐转冷转干，北方旱蝗频仍，是黄巢起义的背景。

periods.name: Medieval warm period (Northern Song)
periods.summary: A warm phase that matches Europe's Medieval Warm Period; Champa rice spread and the south boomed.
periods.summary_zh: 与欧洲中世纪暖期相当；占城稻推广，南方经济兴盛。

periods.name: Southern Song cold period
periods.summary: Lake Tai froze hard enough to walk on in 1111 and the lychees of Fuzhou died; the Jurchen came south in 1127.
periods.summary_zh: 1111 年太湖结冰可行车马，福州荔枝冻死；1127 年女真南下。

periods.name: Song–Yuan warm interval
periods.summary: A short return of warmth, when the Mongols built their empire.
periods.summary_zh: 短暂回暖，正值蒙古崛起。

periods.name: Little Ice Age
periods.summary: Five centuries of cold, with the worst decades in the 1450s, 1620s–1690s and 1840s–1870s; each matched waves of drought, famine and revolt.
periods.summary_zh: 持续约五百年的寒冷期，最冷在 1450 年代、1620—1690 年代和 1840—1870 年代，每次都伴随旱荒与民变。

periods.name: Coldest phase of the Little Ice Age
periods.summary: The coldest century in two thousand years: the Huai and the Han froze, the Chongzhen drought ran seven years, and the Ming fell to Li Zicheng and the Qing.
periods.summary_zh: 两千年来最冷的一百年：淮河、汉水封冻，崇祯大旱连续七年，明亡于李自成与清。

periods.name: Modern warming
periods.summary: Temperatures rising faster than at any time in the record.
periods.summary_zh: 升温速度为有记录以来最快。

disasters.name: 4.2-kiloyear aridity event
disasters.area: Northern China and the Loess Plateau
disasters.summary: A centuries-long drying and cooling of the monsoon margin coincided with the decline of the Longshan cultures and fortified sites such as Shimao.
disasters.summary_zh: 季风边缘带持续数百年变干变冷，与龙山文化衰落及石峁等城址的废弃大体同时。

disasters.name: Great Flood of Gun and Yu
disasters.area: Middle and lower Yellow River plain
disasters.summary: Tradition recalls generations of flooding tamed by Yu's dredging; his success is credited with founding the hereditary Xia dynasty. Geologists link it to an outburst flood near Jishi Gorge around 1920 BCE.
disasters.summary_zh: 传说洪水泛滥历时数代，禹疏导河道治水成功，由此开创世袭的夏朝；地质学者将其与约公元前1920年积石峡溃坝洪水相联系。

disasters.name: Lajia earthquake and flood
disasters.area_zh: 青海官亭盆地（黄河上游）
disasters.summary: An earthquake followed by mudflows and Yellow River floods buried the Qijia-culture village of Lajia, preserving victims in their houses.
disasters.summary_zh: 地震之后泥石流与黄河洪水接踵而至，掩埋了齐家文化喇家聚落，罹难者遗骸保存在房址中。

disasters.name: Drying of the Yi and Luo
disasters.area_zh: 伊洛河流域（二里头腹地）
disasters.summary: Later texts say the Yi and Luo rivers ran dry and the earth shook under Jie, omens taken to mark the fall of Xia to Tang of Shang.
disasters.summary_zh: 《国语》等称夏桀之时伊、洛竭而地震，被视为夏亡于商汤的征兆。

disasters.name: Seven-year drought of Tang
disasters.summary: Early Shang tradition tells of a seven-year drought ended when Tang offered himself in prayer at the Mulberry Grove, a founding myth of royal rainmaking.
disasters.summary_zh: 传说商初大旱七年，汤以身为牺牲祷于桑林而天降雨，成为王者祈雨的典范。

disasters.name: Floods behind Shang capital moves
disasters.summary: Traditional accounts blame repeated Yellow River floods (e.g. Geng 'ruined by the river' under Zu Yi) for the Shang capital moving from Ao to Xing and finally to Yin.
disasters.summary_zh: 传统记载将商代屡次迁都归因于河患，如祖乙“圮于耿”，都城由隞迁邢，终至盘庚迁殷。

disasters.name: Western Zhou cold spell
disasters.summary: The Bamboo Annals record that under King Xiao great hail killed oxen and horses and the Han and Yangtze froze, part of a cold phase of the early first millennium BCE.
disasters.summary_zh: 《竹书纪年》载孝王时大雨雹，牛马死，江、汉俱冻，反映公元前一千纪初的寒冷期。

disasters.name: Great drought of Gonghe and King Xuan
disasters.area: Guanzhong and the Zhou royal domain
disasters.summary: A multi-year drought late in the Gonghe regency, remembered in the ode 'Yun Han', greeted King Xuan's accession and strained the Zhou restoration.
disasters.summary_zh: 共和末年连年大旱，延续至宣王初年，《诗经·云汉》即咏此旱，困扰宣王中兴。

disasters.name: Three Rivers earthquake
disasters.area: Wei, Jing and Luo valleys, Guanzhong
disasters.summary: The Jing, Wei and Luo rivers shook and ran dry and Mount Qi collapsed; the Grand Historian of Zhou read it as a sign of doom, and Haojing fell nine years later.
disasters.summary_zh: 西周幽王二年泾、渭、洛三川皆震，川竭岐山崩，伯阳父以为周将亡；九年后镐京陷落，平王东迁。

disasters.name: Famine of Jin and Qin
disasters.summary: Qin shipped grain to famine-struck Jin in the 'boat relief'; when Qin starved next year Jin refused aid, leading to war and Duke Hui's capture at Hanyuan.
disasters.summary_zh: 晋饥，秦输粟于晋，即“泛舟之役”；次年秦饥而晋闭籴，两国交兵，晋惠公被俘于韩原。

disasters.name: First recorded Yellow River shift
disasters.summary: The Yellow River abandoned its northern 'Yu course' at Sujukou, the first course change recorded in the sources.
disasters.summary_zh: 周定王五年河徙宿胥口，黄河离开“禹河”故道，是史载第一次大改道。

disasters.name: Collapse of Mount Liang
disasters.summary: Mount Liang collapsed and blocked the Yellow River for three days, an event that alarmed the court of Jin.
disasters.summary_zh: 鲁成公五年梁山崩，壅河三日不流，晋君为之降服减膳。

disasters.name: Famine in Zheng and Song
disasters.summary: Zheng and Song suffered famine; the Han clan of Zheng and Zihan of Song distributed grain, boosting the standing of ministers such as Zichan's circle.
disasters.summary_zh: 郑、宋饥，郑子皮发粟、宋子罕请贷，卿族以赈济收揽民心，子产随即执政。

disasters.name: Locust plague and epidemic in Qin
disasters.summary: Locusts came from the east and blotted out the sky, followed by epidemic; Qin sold rank for grain, an early sign of Lü Buwei's fiscal expedients.
disasters.summary_zh: 秦王政四年蝗虫从东方来，蔽天，天下疫；秦令百姓纳粟千石拜爵一级。

disasters.name: Guanzhong famine of the Chu–Han war
disasters.toll_zh: 人相食，令民就食蜀汉
disasters.summary: During the Chu–Han war rice cost 5,000 cash a measure and people ate each other; Liu Bang sent the starving to Shu and Han while holding Xingyang.
disasters.summary_zh: 楚汉相争之际关中大饥，米斛五千，人相食，刘邦令民就食蜀汉，坚守荥阳。

disasters.name: Wudu mountain collapse
disasters.toll_zh: 杀七百六十人
disasters.summary: A mountain collapse in Wudu killed 760 people, and a further quake there in 180 BCE added to the omens of Empress Lü's last years.
disasters.summary_zh: 高后二年武都道山崩，杀七百六十人，后又地震，被视为吕后专政之灾异。

disasters.name: Drought and locusts under Emperor Wen
disasters.summary: Drought and locusts struck while the Xiongnu raided Shang and Yunzhong, forcing Emperor Wen to open hunting parks and sell rank for grain.
disasters.summary_zh: 文帝后元六年天下旱蝗，匈奴入上郡、云中，朝廷弛山泽、令民入粟拜爵以济饥。

disasters.name: Huzi breach of the Yellow River
disasters.summary: The Yellow River broke at Huzi and flooded sixteen commanderies for over twenty years; Emperor Wu finally led the closing of the breach in 109 BCE.
disasters.summary_zh: 元光三年河决瓠子，东南注巨野，通于淮泗，泛滥十六郡二十余年，元封二年武帝亲临堵口。

disasters.name: Guandong floods and resettlement
disasters.toll_zh: 徙民七十二万五千口
disasters.summary: Floods left the eastern plain starving; Emperor Wu moved over 700,000 people to the northwest frontier, helping push the state monopolies of salt and iron.
disasters.summary_zh: 元狩三年山东被水灾，民多饥乏，汉廷徙贫民七十余万口于关西及朔方以南新秦中，财政困窘促成盐铁官营。

disasters.name: Two million Guandong refugees
disasters.toll_zh: 流民二百万口
disasters.summary: After years of floods and wartime levies two million people were adrift in the east, 400,000 of them off the registers; the court debated mass resettlement.
disasters.summary_zh: 元封四年关东流民二百万口，无名数者四十万，公卿议请徙流民于边。

disasters.name: Xiongnu snow disaster after Li Guangli
disasters.summary: After the Xiongnu sacrificed the captured general Li Guangli, months of snow killed livestock and brought disease and crop failure, weakening the Shanyu.
disasters.summary_zh: 匈奴杀李广利以祠，随后连雨雪数月，畜产死，人民疫病，谷稼不熟，单于恐惧。

disasters.name: Great snow on the Xiongnu
disasters.summary: Returning from war with the Wusun and Han, the Xiongnu were caught by a snowfall over ten feet deep; fewer than one in ten people and herds survived.
disasters.summary_zh: 本始三年匈奴击乌孙还，会天大雨雪，一日深丈余，人民畜产冻死，还者不能什一，从此衰耗。

disasters.name: Earthquake of 49 commanderies
disasters.toll_zh: 死六千余人
disasters.summary: Earthquakes struck 49 commanderies and kingdoms, collapsing mountains and killing over 6,000 in Beihai and Langya; Emperor Xuan issued a penitential amnesty.
disasters.summary_zh: 本始四年郡国四十九地震，或山崩水出，北海、琅邪坏祖宗庙，杀六千余人，宣帝下诏罪己大赦。

disasters.name: Xiongnu famine
disasters.summary: Famine killed six or seven tenths of the Xiongnu people and stock, setting the stage for the succession wars and Huhanye's submission to Han.
disasters.summary_zh: 地节二年匈奴饥，人民畜产死十六七，内乱随之，终致呼韩邪单于附汉。

disasters.name: Guandong famine of Emperor Yuan
disasters.toll_zh: 人相食
disasters.summary: Floods and famine in the east led to cannibalism; the cost of relief was a key argument for abandoning the commanderies on Hainan.
disasters.summary_zh: 初元年间关东连年水灾，大饥，人相食；贾捐之以关东困乏为由，力主罢弃珠崖郡。

disasters.name: Dongjun breach
disasters.summary: The river broke at Dongjun and flooded four commanderies and 32 counties; Wang Yanshi closed it in 36 days, and Emperor Cheng renamed the era 'River Calm'.
disasters.summary_zh: 建始四年河决东郡金堤，灌四郡三十二县；王延世三十六日堵塞，改元河平。

disasters.name: Yellow River shift under Wang Mang
disasters.summary: The river burst at Weijun and wandered unchecked for nearly sixty years across the plain, displacing farmers who later fed the Red Eyebrow revolt; Wang Jing finally fixed its new course in 69 CE.
disasters.summary_zh: 始建国三年河决魏郡，泛滥清河以东数郡，王莽不塞，河水改道横流近六十年，流民后成赤眉之众；永平十二年王景治河始定。

disasters.name: Drought and locusts of the late Xin
disasters.area: Jing province, Shandong and the north
disasters.summary: Years of drought and locusts in the Tianfeng era drove famished peasants into the Lülin hills and the Red Eyebrow bands, the revolts that toppled Wang Mang.
disasters.summary_zh: 天凤年间连年旱蝗，饥民相聚为盗，荆州有绿林，青徐有赤眉，终覆新莽。

disasters.name: Locusts reach Chang'an
disasters.toll_zh: 流民数十万
disasters.summary: Locusts flew from the east into Chang'an; hundreds of thousands of refugees poured into the capital and many died, as rebel armies closed in.
disasters.summary_zh: 地皇三年蝗从东方来，飞蔽天，至长安；流民入关数十万，饿死者十之七八，绿林诸军随即兵临。

disasters.name: Famine of the Three Capital regions
disasters.toll_zh: 城郭皆空，白骨蔽野
disasters.summary: With Guanzhong ravaged, cannibalism spread and the cities emptied; the starving Red Eyebrows abandoned Chang'an and surrendered to Liu Xiu.
disasters.summary_zh: 建武二年三辅大饥，人相食，城郭皆空，白骨蔽野；赤眉无食弃长安东归，次年降于光武。

disasters.name: Xiongnu drought and locusts
disasters.summary: Drought and locusts left thousands of li bare and killed over half of the Xiongnu people and herds, prompting the split of the Southern Xiongnu, who submitted to Han in 48.
disasters.summary_zh: 建武二十二年匈奴中连年旱蝗，赤地数千里，草木尽枯，人畜饥疫死耗大半，南匈奴遂分立附汉。

disasters.name: Yongchu floods and famine
disasters.summary: Floods in 41 commanderies, droughts, locusts and quakes beset the Deng regency, overlapping with the great Qiang revolt and the abandonment of the Western Regions.
disasters.summary_zh: 永初元年郡国四十一雨水，此后连年水旱蝗震，邓太后临朝赈济，西羌大乱，西域亦弃。

disasters.name: Longxi earthquake
disasters.summary: An earthquake in Longxi was detected in Luoyang by Zhang Heng's seismoscope before couriers arrived, vindicating the device.
disasters.summary_zh: 永和三年陇西地震，张衡地动仪于洛阳先行感知，驿使数日后至，证其灵验。

disasters.name: Liang province earthquake swarm
disasters.summary: Liang province shook 180 times within a year, splitting mountains and valleys and wrecking towns amid the long Qiang wars.
disasters.summary_zh: 汉安二年凉州地百八十震，山谷坼裂，城寺坏，适逢羌乱连年。

disasters.name: Late Han epidemics
disasters.summary: Epidemics in 171, 173, 179, 182 and 185 swept the eastern plain; Zhang Jue's faith-healing Way of Great Peace grew among the sick and launched the Yellow Turban revolt.
disasters.summary_zh: 建宁四年、熹平二年、光和二年、五年、中平二年屡发大疫，张角以符水治病传太平道，聚众起事为黄巾。

disasters.name: Guanzhong drought and famine
disasters.toll_zh: 人相食，关中无复人迹
disasters.summary: Drought and locusts made grain worth 500,000 cash a measure and people ate each other; the collapse of Guanzhong drove Emperor Xian to flee east.
disasters.summary_zh: 兴平元年三辅大旱，谷一斛五十万，人相食，白骨委积；关中残破，献帝次年东归。

disasters.name: Yan province locusts
disasters.summary: Locusts halted the fighting between Cao Cao and Lü Bu at Puyang as both armies ran out of food; the famine pushed Cao to set up military farms (tuntian).
disasters.summary_zh: 兴平元年蝗虫起，百姓大饿，曹操与吕布相持濮阳，因乏粮各引去；饥荒促成曹操屯田之制。

disasters.name: Plague in Cao Cao's army
disasters.summary: Disease struck Cao Cao's northern troops on the Yangtze, contributing to his defeat at Red Cliffs and the partition into Three Kingdoms.
disasters.summary_zh: 曹军北人南下水土不服，军中大疫，与火攻之败共同导致赤壁战败，三分之势遂成。

disasters.name: Jian'an plague
disasters.summary: A great epidemic killed whole households and four of the Seven Scholars of Jian'an; it weakened Wei on the eve of its fights in Hanzhong and Fancheng.
disasters.summary_zh: 建安二十二年大疫，家家有僵尸之痛，建安七子中四人同岁而亡。

disasters.name: Freezing of the Huai–Yangtze canals
disasters.summary: A severe winter froze the waterways so that Cao Pi's fleet could not enter the Yangtze; he abandoned his invasion of Wu, sighing that Heaven divided north and south.
disasters.summary_zh: 黄初六年冬大寒，水道冰，舟不得入江，曹丕临江叹“天所以限南北也”，引军还。

disasters.name: Luoyang plague of 275
disasters.toll: Over half of Luoyang reported dead
disasters.toll_zh: 洛阳死者太半
disasters.summary: An epidemic killed more than half the people of the capital, Luoyang, a decade after the Jin founding.
disasters.summary_zh: 咸宁元年大疫，洛阳死者以万数，或云太半。

disasters.name: Guanzhong drought and plague
disasters.toll_zh: 流民十万余口入蜀
disasters.summary: Years of drought and epidemic, with rice at 10,000 cash a measure, fuelled Qi Wannian's revolt and drove 100,000 refugees into Hanzhong and Shu under Li Te.
disasters.summary_zh: 元康年间关中连年大旱疾疫，米斛万钱，氐羌齐万年起兵，略阳、天水六郡流民十万入汉中、巴蜀，李特由此起事。

disasters.name: Bing province famine and the Qihuo
disasters.toll_zh: 二万余户流移
disasters.summary: Famine and Xiongnu war emptied Shanxi; some 20,000 households followed Sima Teng to Hebei to beg food, forming the armed 'Qihuo' refugee bands.
disasters.summary_zh: 永兴、光熙年间并州饥荒，又值刘渊起兵，吏民二万余户随司马腾就谷冀州，号为“乞活”。

disasters.name: Yongjia drought and locusts
disasters.summary: In 309 the Yangtze, Han, Yellow and Luo were fordable; in 310 locusts swept six provinces, and famine helped Liu Yao and Shi Le sack Luoyang in 311, sending northern clans south.
disasters.summary_zh: 永嘉三年大旱，江汉河洛皆竭可涉；四年幽并司冀秦雍六州大蝗，草木牛马毛皆尽；饥荒中刘曜、石勒攻陷洛阳，衣冠南渡。

disasters.name: Liaodong Bay freezes
disasters.summary: The bay froze hard enough for Murong Huang to lead his army across the ice and defeat his brother Murong Ren, a sign of the cold fourth century.
disasters.summary_zh: 咸康二年海冰坚厚，慕容皝率军踏冰渡海三百余里袭灭慕容仁，反映四世纪寒冷气候。

disasters.name: Pingcheng drought and famine
disasters.summary: Drought brought severe famine to the Northern Wei capital region and Xiaowen let the starving leave to seek food; the cold, dry north was among reasons for moving to Luoyang in 493.
disasters.summary_zh: 太和十一年大旱，京都民饥，诏听民出关就食；平城寒旱、漕运艰难，为孝文帝迁都洛阳的原因之一。

disasters.name: Fushan dam burst
disasters.toll_zh: 十余万口漂没
disasters.summary: The huge dam Liang built across the Huai to flood Wei-held Shouyang collapsed in autumn floods, drowning over 100,000 people downstream.
disasters.summary_zh: 梁筑浮山堰欲灌北魏寿阳，天监十五年秋淮水暴涨堰坏，沿淮城戍村落十余万口皆漂入海。

disasters.name: Northern frontier famine
disasters.summary: Famine on the steppe sent Anagui's Rouran raiding; starving garrison troops refused relief were the spark of the Six Garrisons revolt that wrecked Northern Wei.
disasters.summary_zh: 正光四年柔然大饥，阿那瓌入寇；怀荒镇民请粮不给，杀镇将起事，六镇之乱由此爆发。

disasters.name: 536 volcanic winter
disasters.area: Guanzhong, North China and the south
disasters.toll: Western Wei: 70–80% of Guanzhong said to die
disasters.toll_zh: 关中死者十七八
disasters.summary: A volcanic dust veil dimmed the sun; Liang saw 'yellow dust falling like snow' and summer frost, while Guanzhong starved and Western Wei faced Gao Huan's invasion at Shayuan.
disasters.summary_zh: 536年火山尘幕遮日，南朝“雨黄尘如雪”、夏霜；关中大饥，人相食，死者十七八，东魏乘机西进而有沙苑之战。

disasters.name: Jiangnan famine of Hou Jing's war
disasters.toll_zh: 千里绝烟
disasters.summary: War with Hou Jing, drought and locusts emptied the lower Yangtze; 'for a thousand li no smoke rose', ending the prosperity of the southern dynasties' heartland.
disasters.summary_zh: 侯景之乱中旱蝗相继，江南大饥，千里绝烟，人迹罕见，白骨成聚，南朝元气大伤。

disasters.name: Snow at the siege of Jinyang
disasters.summary: Weeks of heavy snow broke the Zhou–Turk siege of Northern Qi's Jinyang; frozen and starving, the allies retreated with heavy losses.
disasters.summary_zh: 北周与突厥围晋阳，大雪数旬，平地数尺，联军冻馁，大败而退。

disasters.name: Turkic famine and split
disasters.summary: Drought and famine forced the Turks to grind bones for food just as Sui struck back; the Khaganate split into eastern and western halves.
disasters.summary_zh: 开皇初突厥连年饥荒，屑骨为粮，又遭隋军反击，遂分裂为东西二部。

disasters.name: Guanzhong drought of 594
disasters.summary: Drought forced Emperor Wen to lead the starving of the capital east to Luoyang to eat, exposing the capital's dependence on grain from the east.
disasters.summary_zh: 开皇十四年关中大旱，人饥，文帝率百姓就食洛阳，暴露京师对关东漕粮的依赖。

disasters.name: Shandong–Henan floods of 611
disasters.summary: Floods drowned more than thirty commanderies just as the Goguryeo war levies began; Wang Bo and Dou Jiande rose at Changbai mountain and Gaoji.
disasters.summary_zh: 大业七年山东、河南大水，漂没三十余郡，又值征辽之役，王薄起于长白山，窦建德等起兵。

disasters.name: Drought and plague of 612
disasters.summary: Great drought followed by epidemic killed many, worst in Shandong, while the failed Goguryeo campaign drained men and grain; revolts multiplied.
disasters.summary_zh: 大业八年天下旱，复大疫，人多死，山东尤甚；征辽失利，盗贼蜂起。

disasters.name: Great snow of the Eastern Turks
disasters.summary: Deep snow killed the Eastern Turks' herds and set off famine and revolts against Illig Qaghan; Tang seized the chance and destroyed the khaganate in 630.
disasters.summary_zh: 贞观初突厥大雪，平地数尺，羊马多死，人大饥，诸部叛离颉利；唐乘机出兵，四年灭东突厥。

disasters.name: Locusts of 628
disasters.summary: Drought and locusts struck the capital region; Taizong famously swallowed locusts in the park, and ransomed children sold in the famine.
disasters.summary_zh: 贞观二年京畿旱蝗，太宗入苑吞蝗以示与民同忧，并出御府金帛赎回饥民所鬻子女。

disasters.name: Guanzhong famine of 682
disasters.toll_zh: 死者枕藉于路
disasters.summary: Floods, locusts and epidemic sent rice to 300 cash a measure; Emperor Gaozong took the court to Luoyang to eat, where Wu Zetian later based her regime.
disasters.summary_zh: 永淳元年关中先水后旱、蝗疫，米斗三百，人相食；高宗率百官就食东都，洛阳由此成为武周神都。

disasters.name: Guanzhong famine of 709
disasters.summary: Rice reached 100 cash a measure and officials urged a move to Luoyang, but Zhongzong refused to become a 'grain-chasing Son of Heaven'.
disasters.summary_zh: 景龙三年关中饥，米斗百钱，群臣请幸东都，中宗以“岂有逐粮天子”拒之。

disasters.name: Kaiyuan locusts
disasters.summary: Against fears that killing locusts angered Heaven, chancellor Yao Chong ordered them burned and buried, saving the harvest.
disasters.summary_zh: 开元三、四年山东大蝗，姚崇力排众议，令夜设火、坑焚掩埋，蝗害得以遏止。

disasters.name: Qinzhou earthquake
disasters.toll_zh: 压死四千余人
disasters.summary: A strong quake destroyed Qinzhou's walls and buildings and killed over 4,000; the prefecture seat was moved.
disasters.summary_zh: 开元二十二年秦州地震，廨宇及居人庐舍崩坏殆尽，压死四千余人，州治移徙。

disasters.name: Tianbao autumn rains
disasters.summary: Sixty days of rain ruined the harvest; Yang Guozhong showed the emperor good grain and silenced reports, a famous image of the cover-ups before An Lushan rebelled.
disasters.summary_zh: 天宝十三载秋霖雨六十余日，京城米贵；杨国忠取禾之善者献之，言雨不害稼，次年安禄山起兵。

disasters.name: Jiangdong epidemic
disasters.summary: After war and heavy taxes, a great epidemic in the southeast killed over half the people, as Yuan Chao's rebellion swept Zhejiang.
disasters.summary_zh: 宝应元年江东大疫，死者过半，袁晁乘乱起于台州。

disasters.name: Zhenyuan locusts and drought
disasters.toll_zh: 饿殍枕道
disasters.summary: Locusts darkened the sky from the sea to the Gansu corridor, eating even the hair off animals; the famine came amid the Jingyuan mutiny and the revolts of the four princes.
disasters.summary_zh: 兴元、贞元之际蝗旱相继，东自海，西尽河陇，群飞蔽天，草木牛畜毛靡有孑遗，饿殍枕道。

disasters.name: Guanzhong drought of 803–804
disasters.summary: Drought ruined Guanzhong while officials still pressed taxes; Han Yu was exiled for reporting it, and the misrule fed the reform push of 805.
disasters.summary_zh: 贞元十九年至二十年关中大旱，京兆尹李实仍急征租税，韩愈上书言之被贬阳山；次年永贞革新。

disasters.name: Uyghur famine and snow
disasters.summary: Famine, epidemic and heavy snow killed the Uyghurs' sheep and horses; weakened, the khaganate fell to the Kyrgyz in 840 and its people fled south and west.
disasters.summary_zh: 开成四年回鹘饥疫，又大雪，羊马多死，次年为黠戛斯所破，部众南迁西走。

disasters.name: Drought and locusts before Huang Chao
disasters.summary: Drought and locusts left the eastern plain without harvests while taxes kept being pressed; Wang Xianzhi and Huang Chao rose in 874–875.
disasters.summary_zh: 咸通末、乾符初关东连年旱蝗，州县不以实闻，租税不减，王仙芝、黄巢相继起事。

disasters.name: Huainan famine and siege of Yangzhou
disasters.toll_zh: 扬州户口殆尽
disasters.summary: Locusts and war brought famine; in besieged Yangzhou people ate each other and the city's riches were lost, before Yang Xingmi took control of Huainan.
disasters.summary_zh: 光启年间淮南蝗旱，秦彦、毕师铎、孙儒相攻，扬州被围，城中人相食，繁华荡尽，杨行密终据淮南。

disasters.name: Floods of 925
disasters.summary: Floods ruined harvests and soldiers' families starved in Luoyang while the court hoarded; discontent fed the mutinies that killed Zhuangzong in 926.
disasters.summary_zh: 同光三年天下大水，洛阳军士妻子饿死，而宫中聚敛不恤，次年兵变，庄宗遇弑。

disasters.name: Later Jin drought and locusts
disasters.toll_zh: 饿死者数十万
disasters.summary: Drought and locusts killed hundreds of thousands, while officials kept seizing grain; the weakened Later Jin broke with the Khitan and fell in 947.
disasters.summary_zh: 天福八年春旱夏蝗，天下饥，民饿死者数十万，而括民谷不止；后晋国力衰竭，终为契丹所灭。

disasters.name: Huazhou breach of 944
disasters.summary: The Yellow River broke at Huazhou and flooded five prefectures around Liangshan marsh, which grew into the vast lake of later legend.
disasters.summary_zh: 开运元年河决滑州，浸汴、曹、单、濮、郓五州，环梁山合于汶，梁山泊由此扩大。

disasters.name: Yellow River breaches under Later Zhou
disasters.summary: Repeated breaches since the 940s flooded Shandong until Shizong sent Li Gu with 60,000 labourers to rebuild the dikes, part of Later Zhou's revival.
disasters.summary_zh: 显德元年河决杨刘，东流数十州，世宗命李谷发丁夫六万筑堤，河患稍息。

disasters.name: Shanghu breach: Yellow River turns north
disasters.summary: The Yellow River broke through at Shanghu (Puyang) and swung north to reach the sea near Tianjin, flooding Hebei and sending hundreds of thousands of refugees south.
disasters.summary_zh: 黄河在澶州商胡埽决口，改道北流至天津一带入海，河北大水，流民数十万南下。

disasters.name: Xining drought and the Refugee Scroll
disasters.summary: A long drought and locusts drove refugees toward Kaifeng; Zheng Xia's painting of starving migrants reached Emperor Shenzong and helped force Wang Anshi's first dismissal.
disasters.summary_zh: 连年大旱兼蝗灾，流民涌向开封；郑侠绘《流民图》上呈神宗，促成王安石第一次罢相。

disasters.name: Lake Tai freezes over
disasters.summary: In the winter of 1111 Lake Tai froze hard enough to walk on and the Dongting citrus groves died, a marker of the twelfth-century cold phase that historians link to northern nomad pressure.
disasters.summary_zh: 政和元年冬太湖结冰可行人，洞庭山柑橘尽冻死，是十二世纪寒冷期的标志之一。

disasters.name: Du Chong breaches the Yellow River
disasters.area: Henan, Shandong and the Huai plain
disasters.toll_zh: 一般估计溺死二十万人以上
disasters.summary: To block the advancing Jurchen, the Song commander Du Chong cut the Yellow River dikes near Huazhou; the river began draining southeast through the Si and Huai, the start of 700 years of Huai-basin flooding.
disasters.summary_zh: 南宋东京留守杜充为阻金兵，在滑州附近决黄河，河水东南经泗水入淮，开启黄河夺淮的七百年。

disasters.name: Zhedong drought and Zhu Xi's relief
disasters.summary: Drought and famine in eastern Zhejiang led the court to send Zhu Xi as relief commissioner; his impeachment of local officials and promotion of community granaries made famine relief a Neo-Confucian cause.
disasters.summary_zh: 浙东旱饥，朝廷派朱熹提举浙东常平茶盐公事救荒；他弹劾贪吏、推广社仓，使荒政成为理学关怀。

disasters.name: Yangwu breach: Yellow River captures the Huai
disasters.summary: Under the Jin, the river broke at Yangwu and flowed southeast into the Huai, a course that lasted until 1855 and wrecked the drainage of the Huai plain.
disasters.summary_zh: 金明昌五年黄河在阳武决口，东南夺淮入海，此道延续至1855年，淮北水系从此紊乱。

disasters.name: Epidemic in besieged Kaifeng
disasters.toll_zh: 《金史》称五十日出死者九十余万（或有夸大）
disasters.summary: During the Mongol siege of the Jin capital an epidemic swept the city; the Jin history reports some 900,000 coffins carried out in fifty days, and the dynasty fell two years later.
disasters.summary_zh: 蒙古围攻金都汴京期间城中大疫，《金史》称五十日间出城死者九十余万，两年后金亡。

disasters.name: Mongols flood the Song advance
disasters.summary: When Song armies marched to retake Kaifeng and Luoyang after the fall of Jin, the Mongols broke the Yellow River dikes north of Kaifeng, flooding the Song line of advance and helping wreck the campaign.
disasters.summary_zh: 端平入洛时，蒙古军在开封北寸金淀决黄河灌宋军，宋军进退失据而溃。

disasters.name: Sickness in the Mongol camp at Diaoyu
disasters.summary: Summer heat and disease struck Möngke's army besieging Diaoyu Fortress; the Great Khan died there, whether of illness or wounds, halting the conquest of Song and triggering the Kublai–Ariq Böke war.
disasters.summary_zh: 蒙哥围攻钓鱼城，暑热疾疫流行，蒙哥死于军中（病死或伤死说法不一），攻宋中止并引发汗位之争。

disasters.name: Wuping earthquake
disasters.area_zh: 武平路（今内蒙古宁城一带）
disasters.toll_zh: 传统记载约十万人死亡
disasters.summary: A strong earthquake shook Wuping circuit north of Dadu, flattening towns and killing many in the region around Huizhou and Daning.
disasters.summary_zh: 大都以北武平路强震，城郭庐舍多毁，死伤甚众。

disasters.name: Hongdong earthquake
disasters.toll_zh: 估计死亡二十万至四十七万余人
disasters.summary: A great earthquake struck Pingyang and Taiyuan circuits in Shanxi, one of the deadliest in Chinese history; aftershocks and relief burdens lasted years.
disasters.summary_zh: 山西平阳、太原路大地震，为中国历史上最惨烈的地震之一，余震与赈济持续数年。

disasters.name: Epidemics of the early 1330s
disasters.area: Hebei and the North China Plain
disasters.summary: Yuan annals record mass deaths from epidemic, drought and flood in Hebei and elsewhere; some historians have linked these outbreaks to the origins of the Black Death, though the connection is debated.
disasters.summary_zh: 元代史籍载河北等地疫病、旱涝致大量死亡；有学者将其与黑死病起源相联系，但尚存争议。

disasters.name: Baimao breach and Jia Lu's river works
disasters.summary: The Yellow River burst at Baimao and flooded Shandong and Henan for seven years, ruining the Grand Canal and salt works; Jia Lu's 1351 levy of some 170,000 labourers to close it gave the Red Turbans their rallying ground.
disasters.summary_zh: 黄河白茅堤决口，山东、河南泛滥七年，运河盐场受损；1351年贾鲁征发十七万民夫堵口，“石人一只眼”谶语遂引发红巾起义。

disasters.name: Drought, locusts and plague in Huaibei
disasters.summary: Drought, locusts and epidemic killed Zhu Yuanzhang's parents and elder brother within weeks; the orphan became a monk-beggar and later joined the Red Turbans, eventually founding the Ming.
disasters.summary_zh: 濠州旱蝗大疫，朱元璋父母兄长相继病饿而死；他出家为僧、行乞四方，后投红巾军，终建明朝。

disasters.name: Famine and epidemic at Dadu
disasters.toll_zh: 《元史》载京城周围收埋尸骨约二十万
disasters.summary: With the Grand Canal and sea grain route cut by rebels, famine and plague struck the Yuan capital; the eunuch Pak Bulhwa had about 200,000 corpses buried outside the city walls.
disasters.summary_zh: 红巾军与张士诚等割断漕运与海运，大都饥疫交加，宦官朴不花于城外收埋尸骨约二十万具。

disasters.name: Xinxiang breach and Shawan canal crisis
disasters.summary: The Yellow River broke near Xinxiang and swept northeast into the Grand Canal at Shawan, threatening grain shipments to Beijing just as the Tumu crisis struck; Xu Youzhen closed the breach in 1455.
disasters.summary_zh: 黄河在新乡八柳树决口，东北冲入运河沙湾，危及京师漕运，又逢土木之变；1455年徐有贞治河堵口。

disasters.name: Great snows of the Jingtai winter
disasters.toll: Tens of thousands reported frozen to death
disasters.toll_zh: 冻死者以万计
disasters.summary: Weeks of heavy snow buried the Huai and lower Yangtze; the Huai froze, the sea ice extended dozens of li from the coast, and large numbers of people and livestock froze to death.
disasters.summary_zh: 景泰四年冬至次春，江淮大雪数尺，淮河封冻，沿海结冰四十余里，人畜冻死甚众。

disasters.name: Chenghua drought in the northwest
disasters.toll: Shaanxi alone reported 'millions' displaced or dead
disasters.toll_zh: 陕西一省流亡死者以百万计
disasters.summary: Three years of drought produced famine with reports of cannibalism across Shaanxi, Shanxi and Henan; millions fled, adding to the floating population of the Jingxiang hills.
disasters.summary_zh: 陕、晋、豫连年大旱，“人相食”，流民数百万，荆襄山区流民问题加剧。

disasters.name: Zhangqiu breach and Liu Daxia's dike
disasters.summary: Repeated breaches culminating at Zhangqiu cut the Grand Canal; Liu Daxia closed the gap and built the Taihang dike, pushing the river permanently south into the Huai to protect the canal.
disasters.summary_zh: 黄河屡决，终于张秋冲断运河；刘大夏堵口并筑太行堤，使黄河全流南下夺淮以保漕运。

disasters.name: Jiajing drought in the north
disasters.summary: Drought and famine struck the north in the early Jiajing reign; Lin Xi's 'Famine Relief Memorial' with illustrations became a classic of Ming relief administration.
disasters.summary_zh: 嘉靖初北方大旱饥荒，林希元上《荒政丛言》，成为明代荒政名篇。

disasters.name: Jiajing Huaxian earthquake
disasters.toll_zh: 明代记载约八十三万人死亡
disasters.summary: The deadliest recorded earthquake in history collapsed the loess cave dwellings of the Wei valley; the disaster deepened the fiscal strain of the Jiajing court.
disasters.summary_zh: 嘉靖三十四年末渭河谷地大地震，窑洞成片坍塌，为有记载以来死亡最多的地震。

disasters.name: Gaojiayan breach and the Huai floods
disasters.summary: The Huai broke through the Gaojiayan dike and the Yellow River silted the canal at Qingkou, flooding Huai'an and Yangzhou; Zhang Juzheng appointed Pan Jixun, whose 'confine the river to scour the silt' policy shaped river control for centuries.
disasters.summary_zh: 淮决高家堰、黄河淤塞清口，淮扬一片汪洋；张居正起用潘季驯，“束水攻沙”之法影响治河数百年。

disasters.name: Wanli drought and epidemic
disasters.area: North China and the Yangtze delta
disasters.summary: Successive droughts and an epidemic (possibly plague) swept Shanxi, Hebei, Henan and Jiangnan in the late 1580s; famine relief drained the treasury that Zhang Juzheng had built up.
disasters.summary_zh: 万历十五至十七年南北连旱，山西、北直隶、河南及江南疫疠流行，赈济耗尽张居正积累的国库。

disasters.name: Shandong famine
disasters.summary: Drought and locusts in Shandong brought famine with reports of cannibalism, while Wanli's mining tax eunuchs kept squeezing the province; unrest grew on the eve of the Manchu war.
disasters.summary_zh: 山东旱蝗大饥，人相食，而矿监税使仍横征暴敛，民变迭起，正值后金崛起前夜。

disasters.name: Chongzhen megadrought
disasters.toll: Millions dead; North China population fell sharply
disasters.toll_zh: 死亡以百万计，北方人口锐减
disasters.summary: The worst drought in five centuries, amid the coldest phase of the Little Ice Age, ruined North China; famine fed the Shaanxi revolts that grew into Li Zicheng's and Zhang Xianzhong's armies and brought down the Ming.
disasters.summary_zh: 小冰期最冷阶段遭遇五百年来最严重的干旱，北方赤地千里；饥民蜂起，发展为李自成、张献忠大军，终致明亡。

disasters.name: Late-Ming locust plagues
disasters.summary: Locust swarms followed the drought across Henan, Shandong, Hebei and into Jiangnan, stripping fields bare; in Henan the hungry joined Li Zicheng, who took Luoyang in 1641 with the slogan of grain and no taxes.
disasters.summary_zh: 大旱之后飞蝗遍及豫、鲁、冀并南至江南，禾稼尽食；河南饥民纷纷投奔李自成，1641年破洛阳，“迎闯王，不纳粮”。

disasters.name: Jiangnan famine of the Chongzhen years
disasters.summary: Drought, locusts and then flood struck even the rich Yangtze delta, where rice prices rose several-fold and urban riots broke out, undercutting the Ming's last fiscal base.
disasters.summary_zh: 崇祯十三、十四年江南亦旱蝗相继，米价数倍上涨，城市抢米风潮迭起，明朝最后的财源动摇。

disasters.name: North China plague
disasters.toll: Beijing reportedly lost a fifth or more of its population in 1643
disasters.toll_zh: 1643年京师人口据称死亡五分之一以上
disasters.summary: An epidemic, probably plague, spread from Shanxi across the north; in 1643 it killed a large share of Beijing's people and garrison, leaving the capital nearly defenceless when Li Zicheng arrived.
disasters.summary_zh: 疫病（多认为是鼠疫）自山西蔓延华北，1643年京师死者无数、守军减员，次年李自成兵临城下几无抵抗。

disasters.name: Drowning of Kaifeng
disasters.toll_zh: 城中约三十七万人中约三十万死亡
disasters.summary: During Li Zicheng's third siege the Yellow River dikes were cut (each side blamed the other) and the river poured into the starving city, drowning most of its people.
disasters.summary_zh: 李自成第三次围攻开封时黄河大堤被决（双方互相指责），洪水灌城，城中饥民大多溺死。

disasters.name: Shunzhi frost
disasters.summary: In one of the bitterest winters of the Little Ice Age, Lake Tai and the Han and Huai rivers froze and the Jiangxi and Zhejiang orange groves were killed, while the Qing still fought the Southern Ming.
disasters.summary_zh: 小冰期最严寒的冬季之一，太湖、汉水、淮河封冻，江西、浙江柑橘尽数冻死，时清军仍与南明交战。

disasters.name: Tancheng earthquake
disasters.toll_zh: 约五万人死亡
disasters.summary: One of the largest earthquakes in eastern China (magnitude ~8.5) devastated Tancheng and Juzhou; it became famous through Jonathan Spence's 'The Death of Woman Wang'.
disasters.summary_zh: 郯城、莒州一带发生约8.5级强震，为中国东部最大地震之一，史景迁《王氏之死》即以此为背景。

disasters.name: Kangxi great freeze
disasters.summary: The Han and Huai rivers froze and heavy snow lay for weeks across central China; repeated hard winters of the 1670s coincided with the strains of the Three Feudatories war.
disasters.summary_zh: 汉水、淮河封冻，华中积雪经月；1670年代屡遇严冬，适逢三藩之乱的压力。

disasters.name: Sanhe–Pinggu earthquake
disasters.toll_zh: 约四万五千人死亡
disasters.summary: A magnitude ~8 earthquake east of Beijing damaged the Forbidden City in the midst of the Three Feudatories war; the Kangxi Emperor issued an edict of self-reproach and ordered relief.
disasters.summary_zh: 京东三河、平谷约8级大地震，紫禁城受损，正值三藩之乱；康熙帝下罪己诏，发帑赈济。

disasters.name: Sizhou city sinks beneath Hongze Lake
disasters.summary: Silt from the Yellow River backed up the Huai until floods drowned the prefectural city of Sizhou and the Ming ancestral tombs; Kangxi made river works one of his three great concerns and inspected them on his southern tours.
disasters.summary_zh: 黄河泥沙抬高淮河，洪泽湖扩张淹没泗州城及明祖陵；康熙将河务列为三大事之一，南巡亲阅河工。

disasters.name: Linfen earthquake
disasters.toll_zh: 约五万人死亡（估计）
disasters.summary: A magnitude ~8 earthquake struck Pingyang (Linfen), destroying much of the city and surrounding counties.
disasters.summary_zh: 山西平阳府（临汾）约8级地震，府城及周边州县大半倾圮。

disasters.name: Zhili drought and Qianlong's relief
disasters.toll: Relief to ~2 million people; mortality kept low
disasters.toll_zh: 赈济约二百万口，死亡较少
disasters.summary: A severe drought in Zhili was met by one of the largest relief operations of the High Qing, with granary grain distributed to some two million people, a model of the eighteenth-century famine state.
disasters.summary_zh: 直隶大旱，清廷开仓赈济约二百万人，成为盛清荒政的典范。

disasters.name: Qianlong drought
disasters.area: North China Plain, Huai and lower Yangtze
disasters.summary: Widespread drought and famine in Shandong, Henan, Jiangsu and Anhui exposed failing granaries and corruption under Heshen; the hill regions that absorbed the refugees soon rose in the White Lotus rebellion.
disasters.summary_zh: 鲁、豫、苏、皖大旱饥荒，暴露和珅当政下仓储空虚与吏治腐败；接纳流民的山区不久爆发白莲教起义。

disasters.name: Kangding earthquake and Dadu River flood
disasters.toll_zh: 洪水据称致约十万人死亡
disasters.summary: An earthquake near Kangding triggered a landslide that dammed the Dadu River; when the dam burst ten days later the flood swept hundreds of kilometres downstream.
disasters.summary_zh: 康定附近地震引发山崩堵塞大渡河，十日后堰塞湖溃决，洪水下泻数百公里。

disasters.name: Jiaqing flood of the capital region
disasters.summary: Torrential summer rains broke the Yongding River dikes and flooded Beijing and surrounding Zhili; the newly empowered Jiaqing Emperor organised large-scale relief and soup kitchens.
disasters.summary_zh: 夏季暴雨，永定河决口，京城与直隶多地被淹；亲政不久的嘉庆帝大规模开厂施粥赈济。

disasters.name: Drought of 1813 and the Eight Trigrams
disasters.area: Northern Henan, southern Zhili, western Shandong
disasters.summary: Drought and soaring grain prices in the Henan–Zhili–Shandong border region swelled the Eight Trigrams sect, whose rebels attacked the Forbidden City that autumn.
disasters.summary_zh: 豫、直、鲁交界大旱，粮价飞涨，天理教（八卦教）乘势聚众，当年秋攻入紫禁城。

disasters.name: Tambora cold and the Yunnan famine
disasters.summary: After the eruption of Mount Tambora, three cold summers ruined Yunnan's rice crops; the poet Li Yuyang described the famine, and the crisis pushed farmers toward opium poppy as a hardier cash crop.
disasters.summary_zh: 坦博拉火山爆发后云南连续三年夏季低温，稻谷失收，诗人李于阳记其惨状；危机促使农民改种更耐寒的罂粟。

disasters.name: Daoguang flood
disasters.summary: Prolonged rains flooded the Yangtze delta, the Huai and Zhili at once; the cost of relief and of the decaying Grand Canal pushed the court to experiment with shipping tribute grain by sea in 1826.
disasters.summary_zh: 淫雨连月，江南、江淮与直隶同时大水；赈灾与运河淤废之困，促使清廷于1826年试行漕粮海运。

disasters.name: Yellow River breaches at Kaifeng and Zhongmou
disasters.summary: During the Opium War the Yellow River broke at Xiangfu, besieging Kaifeng with water for months, then at Zhongmou in 1843; the cost of repairs drained a treasury already paying the British indemnity.
disasters.summary_zh: 鸦片战争期间黄河在祥符决口，开封被水围困数月，1843年又决中牟；巨额河工与对英赔款同时掏空国库。

disasters.name: Yangtze flood of 1849
disasters.summary: Catastrophic floods along the middle and lower Yangtze created vast numbers of refugees just before the Taiping uprising; famine in Guangxi and Hunan in 1849–50 fed the rebel ranks.
disasters.summary_zh: 长江中下游特大水灾，流民遍野；1849—1850年广西、湖南亦饥，为太平天国起义提供了兵源。

disasters.name: Tongwaxiang breach: Yellow River turns north
disasters.summary: With the dynasty absorbed by the Taiping war, the river broke at Tongwaxiang and abandoned the Huai, swinging north to enter the sea through Shandong; flooded and leaderless districts fed the Nian rebellion.
disasters.summary_zh: 清廷困于太平天国战事，黄河在铜瓦厢决口，弃淮北徙，夺大清河经山东入海；受灾地区成为捻军根据地。

disasters.name: Xianfeng drought and locusts
disasters.summary: Drought and great locust swarms struck the Huai and lower Yangtze and reached the outskirts of Beijing, deepening famine in the war zones of the Taiping and Nian.
disasters.summary_zh: 大旱继以飞蝗蔽天，自江淮、江南直至京畿，太平军与捻军战区饥荒加剧。

disasters.name: Cholera in the Taiping war zone
disasters.summary: Cholera and other epidemics raged among soldiers and refugees crowded into Shanghai and the delta during the final Taiping campaigns, killing more than battle in some districts.
disasters.summary_zh: 太平天国后期，霍乱等疫病在上海及江南的军民、难民中流行，部分地区死于疫者多于死于兵。

disasters.name: Great Yangtze flood of 1870
disasters.summary: The highest Yangtze flood in centuries, recorded at Yichang, broke the Jingjiang dikes and opened the Songzi channel into Dongting Lake, permanently reshaping the middle river.
disasters.summary_zh: 宜昌出现数百年来最高洪水，荆江大堤溃决，冲开松滋口入洞庭湖，永久改变长江中游水系。

disasters.name: Dingwu Famine
disasters.toll_zh: 约九百万至一千三百万人死亡
disasters.summary: Three years of drought produced one of the deadliest famines in history; Shanxi alone lost about a third of its people, and missionary relief and foreign press coverage spurred new Chinese philanthropy.
disasters.summary_zh: 连续三年大旱，酿成世界史上最惨烈的饥荒之一，山西人口约减三分之一；传教士赈灾与报刊报道催生了新式义赈。

disasters.name: Zhengzhou breach
disasters.toll_zh: 约九十万至二百万人死亡
disasters.summary: The Yellow River broke at Zhengzhou and poured south into the Huai, flooding thousands of villages before the breach was closed in early 1889.
disasters.summary_zh: 黄河在郑州决口，南下夺淮，豫皖数千村庄被淹，至1889年初方合龙。

disasters.name: Bubonic plague in Guangzhou and Hong Kong
disasters.toll_zh: 广州约七万至十万，香港约二千五百人死亡
disasters.summary: Plague spreading from Yunnan reached Guangzhou and Hong Kong, where Yersin identified the bacillus; shipping carried this third pandemic around the world.
disasters.summary_zh: 鼠疫自云南传至广州、香港，耶尔森在港发现鼠疫杆菌；航运将这场第三次鼠疫大流行带往全球。

disasters.name: Floods and drought before the Boxers
disasters.summary: A Yellow River flood in Shandong in 1898 was followed by drought in 1899–1900; idle, hungry young farmers flocked to the Boxer movement, which blamed foreigners and Christians for the lack of rain.
disasters.summary_zh: 1898年山东黄河决口，继以1899—1900年大旱；无事可做的饥饿农民纷纷加入义和团，将天旱归咎于洋人与教民。

disasters.name: Central China famine
disasters.toll: Hundreds of thousands to several million dead (estimates vary widely)
disasters.toll_zh: 死亡数十万至数百万（估计差异很大）
disasters.summary: Floods followed by crop failure caused famine across Huaibei; international relief committees in Shanghai raised record sums, while the crisis fuelled anti-Qing unrest.
disasters.summary_zh: 江淮大水后颗粒无收，淮北大饥；上海华洋义赈会募款空前，社会动荡加剧反清情绪。

disasters.name: Manchurian pneumonic plague
disasters.toll_zh: 约六万人死亡
disasters.summary: Pneumonic plague spread along the railways from Manzhouli to Harbin and beyond; Wu Lien-teh's quarantines, masks and cremations contained it and launched modern Chinese public health.
disasters.summary_zh: 肺鼠疫沿铁路自满洲里传至哈尔滨等地；伍连德推行隔离、口罩与焚尸，控制疫情，开创中国现代防疫。

disasters.name: Yangtze and Huai floods of 1910–11
disasters.summary: Two years of floods and rice riots along the middle Yangtze, including the 1910 Changsha rice riot, left the region seething in the months before the Wuchang Uprising.
disasters.summary_zh: 长江中游连年大水，1910年长沙抢米风潮等民变迭起，民怨沸腾，随后爆发武昌起义。

disasters.name: Hai River flood of 1917
disasters.summary: Summer floods on the Hai River system submerged much of Zhili and Tianjin, displacing millions; Xiong Xiling's relief and river commission marked the start of modern water management in North China.
disasters.summary_zh: 海河水系大水，直隶与天津大片被淹，灾民数百万；熊希龄主持赈务并设顺直水利委员会，开华北近代治水之先。

disasters.name: Haiyuan earthquake
disasters.toll_zh: 约二十万至二十七万人死亡
disasters.summary: A magnitude ~7.8–8.5 earthquake in Haiyuan triggered vast loess landslides that buried whole villages, one of the deadliest quakes of the twentieth century.
disasters.summary_zh: 海原约8.5级大地震，黄土滑坡掩埋整村，为二十世纪最惨烈的地震之一。

disasters.name: North China famine of 1920–21
disasters.toll_zh: 约五十万人死亡，灾民二三千万
disasters.summary: Drought across five northern provinces left some 20–30 million destitute; foreign and Chinese relief agencies (later the China International Famine Relief Commission) held deaths far below 1877 levels.
disasters.summary_zh: 北方五省大旱，灾民二三千万；中外义赈团体（后成立华洋义赈会）救济，使死亡远低于丁戊奇荒。

disasters.name: Gulang earthquake
disasters.toll_zh: 约四万人死亡
disasters.summary: A magnitude ~7.7–8 earthquake shattered Gulang and Wuwei in the Hexi Corridor, compounding the misery of a region about to enter the 1928–30 famine.
disasters.summary_zh: 甘肃古浪约8级地震，古浪、武威等地城毁人亡，随后又陷入1928—1930年大饥荒。

disasters.name: Great Northwest drought
disasters.toll_zh: 估计死亡三百万至一千万人
disasters.summary: Years of drought, warlord requisitions and banditry produced famine across the northwest; Shaanxi's Guanzhong was devastated, and the famine fed the Feng Yuxiang–Chiang conflict and later Communist recruitment in the region.
disasters.summary_zh: 连年大旱加军阀征敛、匪患，西北大饥荒，关中尤惨；灾荒加剧冯玉祥与蒋介石之争，也为日后红军在西北立足埋下伏笔。

disasters.name: Central China floods of 1931
disasters.toll_zh: 死亡约四十二万至二百万以上（有争议）
disasters.summary: After a wet summer the Yangtze, Huai and Han flooded together, submerging Wuhan for months and displacing tens of millions; the Nanjing government's stretched relief came just as Japan seized Manchuria.
disasters.summary_zh: 长江、淮河、汉水同时泛滥，武汉被淹数月，灾民数千万；南京政府疲于赈灾之际日本发动九一八事变。

disasters.name: Yangtze and Han floods of 1935
disasters.toll_zh: 约十四万人死亡
disasters.summary: Torrential rain in the Han and middle Yangtze basins drowned large parts of Hubei and Hunan while the Red Army was on the Long March.
disasters.summary_zh: 汉江与长江中游暴雨成灾，湖北、湖南大片被淹，时值红军长征。

disasters.name: Huayuankou dike breach
disasters.toll_zh: 约四十万至八十九万人死亡，三四百万人流离
disasters.summary: Nationalist troops breached the Yellow River dikes to slow the Japanese advance; the river ran southeast into the Huai until 1947, creating the vast Yellow Flood Zone.
disasters.summary_zh: 国民党军为阻日军决开花园口大堤，黄河改道东南入淮直至1947年，形成黄泛区。

disasters.name: Henan famine
disasters.toll_zh: 约一百万至三百万人死亡，约三百万人逃荒
disasters.summary: Drought on top of war requisitions brought famine to Nationalist-held Henan; reports by Theodore White and others shamed Chongqing, and embittered peasants turned on retreating Nationalist troops during Operation Ichigo.
disasters.summary_zh: 旱灾叠加军粮征敛，国统区河南大饥荒；白修德等人的报道令重庆政府难堪，1944年豫湘桂战役中饥民反戈袭击溃退的国军。

disasters.name: Guangdong famine
disasters.toll: Hundreds of thousands to ~3 million dead (estimates vary)
disasters.toll_zh: 死亡数十万至约三百万（估计不一）
disasters.summary: Drought, the Japanese blockade of rice imports and the cut-off of overseas remittances caused famine in Guangdong, with especially heavy deaths in Taishan and other emigrant counties.
disasters.summary_zh: 旱灾加之日军封锁米粮进口、侨汇断绝，广东大饥荒，台山等侨乡死亡尤重。

disasters.name: Locust plagues of 1943–44
disasters.summary: Locust swarms followed the Henan famine across the North China Plain; in the Communist base areas mass anti-locust campaigns became a showcase of mobilisation.
disasters.summary_zh: 河南饥荒之后飞蝗遍及华北平原；中共根据地组织大规模扑蝗运动，成为群众动员的典范。

disasters.name: Huai River flood of 1950
disasters.summary: Severe floods on the Huai led Mao to order that 'the Huai River must be harnessed', launching the PRC's first great water-control campaign.
disasters.summary_zh: 淮河大水，毛泽东题词“一定要把淮河修好”，开启新中国首个大规模治水工程。

disasters.name: Yangtze and Huai floods of 1954
disasters.toll_zh: 官方统计约三万三千人死亡
disasters.summary: The largest Yangtze flood of the century forced the use of the Jingjiang flood-diversion zone and mass mobilisation to save Wuhan; it revived plans for a Three Gorges dam.
disasters.summary_zh: 本世纪长江最大洪水，启用荆江分洪区并全民动员保卫武汉；三峡建坝计划由此重提。

disasters.name: Great Chinese Famine
disasters.area: Nationwide, worst in Anhui, Sichuan, Henan, Gansu
disasters.toll_zh: 非正常死亡约一千五百万至四千五百万
disasters.summary: Great Leap Forward policies—grain procurement on inflated harvests, communal kitchens and diverted labour—turned poor weather into the deadliest famine in history; it led to Mao's partial retreat and the Lushan purge's legacy.
disasters.summary_zh: 大跃进的浮夸征购、公共食堂与劳力挪用，使不利天气演变为史上最惨烈的饥荒，迫使毛泽东退居二线。

disasters.name: Hai River flood of 1963
disasters.toll_zh: 官方统计约五千六百人死亡
disasters.summary: Record August rains flooded southern and central Hebei; Mao's call to 'harness the Hai River for good' launched a decade of dike and channel building.
disasters.summary_zh: 八月特大暴雨致冀中南大水，毛泽东题词“一定要根治海河”，此后十余年大修河道堤防。

disasters.name: Xingtai earthquake
disasters.toll_zh: 约8064人死亡
disasters.summary: A series of strong quakes struck Xingtai weeks before the Cultural Revolution; Zhou Enlai's visits and his call for earthquake prediction launched China's state seismology programme.
disasters.summary_zh: 文革前夕邢台连发强震；周恩来亲赴灾区并号召开展地震预报，中国地震工作由此起步。

disasters.name: Tonghai earthquake
disasters.toll_zh: 约一万五千六百人死亡
disasters.summary: A magnitude 7.1 quake devastated Tonghai county; amid the Cultural Revolution it was barely reported, and the toll was published only years later.
disasters.summary_zh: 通海7.1级地震，正值文革，当时几乎未作报道，死亡人数多年后才公布。

disasters.name: Banqiao and Shimantan dam failures
disasters.toll: ~26,000 (official) to 240,000 incl. later famine and disease
disasters.toll_zh: 官方约二万六千人，连同后续饥疫或达二十余万
disasters.summary: Typhoon Nina's record rains overtopped and broke the Banqiao, Shimantan and dozens of smaller dams; the disaster was kept secret for years.
disasters.summary_zh: 台风“妮娜”带来特大暴雨，板桥、石漫滩等数十座水库垮坝，灾情长期保密。

disasters.name: Haicheng earthquake
disasters.toll_zh: 约二千人死亡，远少于预期
disasters.summary: Foreshocks led officials to evacuate Haicheng hours before a magnitude 7.3 quake, often cited as the first successful earthquake prediction.
disasters.summary_zh: 前震促使当局在7.3级主震前数小时疏散民众，常被称为首次成功的地震预报。

disasters.name: Tangshan earthquake
disasters.toll_zh: 官方统计约二十四万二千人死亡
disasters.summary: A magnitude 7.6 quake levelled the industrial city of Tangshan; China refused foreign aid, and the disaster, read as an omen, preceded Mao's death and the fall of the Gang of Four.
disasters.summary_zh: 7.6级地震将工业城市唐山夷为平地；中国拒绝外援，民间视为天象异兆，随后毛泽东去世、四人帮倒台。

disasters.name: East China floods of 1991
disasters.toll_zh: 约二千人死亡
disasters.summary: Heavy rains flooded Anhui and Jiangsu; China appealed for international aid for the first time and launched new Huai and Tai lake control works.
disasters.summary_zh: 安徽、江苏特大水灾，中国首次呼吁国际救灾援助，随后加大治淮、治太工程。

disasters.name: 1998 Yangtze and northeast floods
disasters.toll_zh: 约三千至四千余人死亡
disasters.summary: Prolonged floods on the Yangtze and northeast rivers prompted a huge PLA deployment, a logging ban on upper-Yangtze forests and a grain-for-green programme.
disasters.summary_zh: 长江与东北松嫩流域洪水，解放军大规模抗洪；此后实施天然林禁伐与退耕还林。

disasters.name: SARS epidemic
disasters.toll: 349 dead in mainland China; 299 in Hong Kong
disasters.toll_zh: 内地349人、香港299人死亡
disasters.summary: A new coronavirus emerged in Guangdong and spread to Hong Kong, Beijing and abroad; early cover-ups cost Beijing's mayor and the health minister their posts and led to a new disease-reporting system.
disasters.summary_zh: 新型冠状病毒在广东出现并扩散至香港、北京及海外；早期隐瞒导致卫生部长、北京市长被免职，此后建立传染病直报系统。

disasters.name: Southern China snowstorms
disasters.toll_zh: 约129人死亡，受灾数千万人
disasters.summary: Freezing rain and snow brought down power lines and stranded millions of migrant workers travelling home for the Spring Festival, exposing the fragility of national infrastructure.
disasters.summary_zh: 冻雨暴雪压垮电网，春运期间数百万返乡农民工滞留，暴露基础设施的脆弱。

disasters.name: Wenchuan earthquake
disasters.toll_zh: 约六万九千人遇难，一万八千人失踪
disasters.summary: A magnitude 7.9 quake devastated Wenchuan, Beichuan and surrounding counties months before the Beijing Olympics; collapsed schools sparked public anger over shoddy construction.
disasters.summary_zh: 7.9级地震重创汶川、北川等地，正值北京奥运前夕；校舍倒塌引发对“豆腐渣工程”的公众愤怒。

disasters.name: Yushu earthquake
disasters.toll_zh: 约二千七百人遇难
disasters.summary: A magnitude 6.9 quake destroyed most of Jyekundo (Gyêgu), the Tibetan town at the heart of Yushu prefecture; the rebuilding reshaped the town.
disasters.summary_zh: 6.9级地震摧毁玉树州府结古镇大部，灾后重建改变了这座藏区城镇的面貌。

disasters.name: COVID-19 pandemic
disasters.toll: Official ~120,000 dead; excess-death estimates far higher
disasters.toll_zh: 官方约十二万人死亡，超额死亡估计远高于此
disasters.summary: A novel coronavirus first identified in Wuhan led to the city's lockdown and three years of 'zero-COVID' controls; protests in late 2022 preceded the abrupt end of restrictions and a deadly winter wave.
disasters.summary_zh: 新型冠状病毒首先在武汉发现，武汉封城，此后三年实行“动态清零”；2022年底抗议后政策骤然放开，冬季疫情致大量死亡。

disasters.name: Zhengzhou floods
disasters.toll_zh: 官方统计遇难失踪398人
disasters.summary: A record downpour flooded Zhengzhou's subway and road tunnels; an official inquiry later found local authorities had concealed deaths.
disasters.summary_zh: 特大暴雨淹没郑州地铁与隧道；国务院调查认定地方瞒报遇难人数。

disasters.name: Yangtze heatwave and drought
disasters.area: Sichuan, Chongqing and the Yangtze basin
disasters.summary: The most intense heatwave on record dried the Yangtze and Poyang Lake; hydropower shortfalls forced factory shutdowns in Sichuan.
disasters.summary_zh: 有记录以来最强热浪致长江与鄱阳湖水位骤降，四川水电不足、工厂限电停产。

disasters.name: Haihe floods of 2023
disasters.toll: Over 100 dead or missing in Beijing and Hebei
disasters.toll_zh: 京冀遇难失踪逾百人
disasters.summary: Typhoon Doksuri's rains caused the worst Haihe floods in decades; diversion of water into Hebei's flood-storage zones to protect Beijing and Xiong'an drew public criticism.
disasters.summary_zh: 台风“杜苏芮”带来暴雨，海河流域发生数十年来最大洪水；为保北京、雄安而启用河北蓄滞洪区引发争议。
